== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[How Liberty Dies]]: the PC card image of [[How Liberty Dies]] (7 August 2025, [[:File:V25-L-howlibertydies-2025-08-07.png|V25-L-howlibertydies-2025-08-07.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (page 8). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
